description: Intrusion with deliberate false flag. The attacker left traces designed to attribute the attack to a known Russian APT group. VIGÍA must detect the incoherence of intent.
analyst_notes: Case designed to demonstrate Peirce's Thirdness: the intention behind the act, not just the act itself.

peirce_expected.firstness: Cyrillic strings, known APT tool, Tor IP — appearance of a Russian attack
peirce_expected.secondness: mimikatz.exe non-executable on Linux, self-contradicting history, failed exfiltration with empty file — the facts do not support the narrative
peirce_expected.thirdness: The accumulation of 'perfect evidence' that contradicts itself reveals intent to fabricate attribution evidence. The real attacker knew enough to mimic the surface of an APT but not the operational details.
